id.description: Unique identifier of the audit event

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred

organizationId.description: Identifier of the organization in which the event occurred

actorId.description: Identifier of the user or service that performed the action

actorEmail.description: Email address of the actor who performed the action

eventType.description: Type identifier of the audit event

eventSource.description: Service that generated the audit event

eventTarget.description: Category of resource targeted by the action

eventDetails.description: Detailed payload of the audit event in service-specific format

eventSummary.description: Human-readable summary of the audit event
